title: Wrangelstraße, Berlin
description:
This property is a flat located on the 3rd floor of the side wing of an old building dating from 1873. The 5-storey residential building consists of a front building and a side wing and was completely renovated in 2010. The flat is north-west facing and offers a lot of afternoon sun through the four windows. 
A total of 41 m2 divided into a large living room with open kitchen and dining area, a 6 m2 bathroom with bathtub and window and a small hallway. title: Neckarstraße, Berlin
description:
Bright, spacious, beautiful apartment in the heart of the thriving Neukölln district. Wonderfully furnished with a comfortable living room, balcony, kitchen, bathroom and 2 bedrooms.

1 minute walk from U7 Rathaus Neukölln station. Easy access to Berlin Brandenburg airport (BER) and Hauptbahnhof station. Short walk to the beautiful canal and Tempelhofer Feld.

The area is full of trendy cafes, shops, restaurants, bars, supermarkets and is minutes away from Neukölln Arcaden shopping centre.

APARTMENT

Apartment is decorated and furnished to a high standard; clean, comfortable and modern throughout. High speed fibre broadband throughout the apartment. Cosy balcony to enjoy your morning coffee in the Berlin sun. Thoughtful features, such as mounts designed for Sonos speakers and motion-activated floor lighting, add the finishing touches to this stunning apartment.

Living room: fitted with a stunning LG OLED 4K Smart TV, designer corner sofa and original hardwood flooring. It's the perfect place to sit back and relax.

Kitchen: beautiful open space, fully equipped with high-end built-in AEG Electrolux appliances (including an induction hob, fan oven with steam function, microwave, washing machine, dishwasher and pull out tap in a large sink). Coupled with a sturdy pull-out dining table, the kitchen is perfect for quick meals or eloquent dinner parties.

Bathroom: the pièce de résistance - a wonderfully modern bathroom, fitted with a Grohe walk-in rain shower, floating WC and large sink. Plenty of storage space in the under-sink cupboard, with thoughtful shelving space on the mountain grey tiles. Coupled with spotlights and under-mirror LED lighting, you'll look forward to getting up in the morning.

Master bedroom: fully equipped with a double bed, premium SIMBA mattress, bedside tables and large sliding cupboard.

Second bedroom: fully equipped with a single bed that slides out to become a double (on the same level), spacious cupboard and desk. Beautiful balcony. The perfect second bedroom and/or office space.

Cellar: spacious underground cellar provided for additional storage space - ideal for guests with plenty of belongings!

Cleaning service available from an experienced, reliable cleaner.

COMMUNAL SPACE

Access to a communal garden (inner courtyard) with space to park bicycles.

The apartment complex has undergone a modernisation programme to improve the appearance, safety, functionality and overall quality of the property. Some works relating to shared areas of the complex are scheduled, such as works in the courtyard, bicycle parking areas, basement areas and entrance gates.

These works are coordinated by the property management company and carried out by approved and certified contractors in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, including health and safety, security and permitted working hours. Guests are asked to take care in any areas where work may be taking place.

What this means for you:

- The accommodation is exactly as described and guests will not be required to leave the property at any time
- Works take place during legally permitted hours only
- There may be some temporary noise or restrictions in shared areas

If you have any questions during your stay, please feel free to get in touch. We appreciate your understanding.

title: Richardstraße, Berlin
description: The apartment is fully furnished and offers a living area of approximately 80 sqm, distributed across four rooms: two bedrooms, a kitchen, a bathroom, and a dining room with a sofa bed. It is ideal for two people and features an upscale interior that creates a stylish and comfortable atmosphere. In the entrance area, there is a small built-in closet with storage space for essential household appliances and the washing machine. From the entrance area, you can access the dining room, bathroom, and kitchen. One of the two spacious bedrooms is equipped with a large, comfortable box spring bed (180 x 200 cm), a large wardrobe, a cupboard, and a desk. The second bedroom also has a large, comfortable box spring bed (160 x 200 cm), a desk, a large sofa with a table for relaxing, as well as a wardrobe and a chest of drawers. Both bedrooms are equipped with a TV. The fitted kitchen includes a refrigerator with a small freezer compartment, a dishwasher, and a stove-oven combination. All necessary appliances such as a coffee machine, toaster, and kettle are available to prepare your own meals effortlessly. The bathroom is equipped with a shower, a toilet, and a sink. The apartment is located in one of the trendiest and most beautiful areas in Berlin-Neukölln and offers perfect infrastructure with numerous restaurants, cafés, bars, and shopping opportunities. The Karl-Marx-Straße (U7) subway station is just a few minutes' walk away. The apartment is equipped with towels and bed linen, so you only need to bring your personal belongings and can feel at home. The monthly rent includes free WiFi and all incidental costs. A separate parking space on the premises can be rented for 125 EUR/month.

title: Richardstraße, Berlin
description:
This fully furnished apartment in an historic old building and has a living space of approx. 70 sqm, allocated across 3 rooms. Its perfect for a couple, two singles or a small family. The apartment has two bedrooms, a living/dining room, a kitchen, and a bathroom, making it perfect for one or two people. Refinished walls with large windows, woodenstyle floorboards, and sophisticated furnishing create a stylish ambience. 
From the spacious entry, you can enter the bathroom with a shower, one of the bedrooms and the living room. From the living room, you enter the kitchen and through that, you will arrive in the other bedroom. Both bedrooms have a large comfortable beds. There is also a large wardrobe. The cosy living area has a comfortable sofa with coffee table and a large chair for relaxing. You will also find the TV here as well. 
The kitchen has been newly installed and is fully fitted with everything you'll need: a large refrigerator with freezer, a dishwasher, a washing machine as well as a stove and oven combination. In addition, you will find new appliances such as a coffee machine, toaster, and kettle, which are necessary for everyday life. The dining table is in a cosy, seprated area next to the kitchen. The bathroom is equipped with a full-sized shower, a toilet, and a sink. Thoughtfully placed shelving and modern decor makes this apartment easy to move into and live comfortably right away. All rooms have windows, flooding the apartment with lots of natural light. 
The apartment is located in one of the most upcoming, hippest and most beautiful areas in Berlin-Neukölln, and offers perfect amenities with its numerous restaurants, cafés and bars, as well as shopping facilities. You can reach the excellent Berlin public transport via Karl-Marx-Platz (U7), which is only 5 minutes' walking distance away. 
The apartment is equipped with towels and bed linen, so you only have to bring your personal belongings and can immediately feel at home.  The monthly rent includes free WiFi and all additional costs. 
A separate parking space on the property is available for rent as well (EUR 125,- /month).

title: Columbiadamm, Berlin
description:
Welcome to your tranquil oasis in the vibrant Schillerkiez neighborhood! This stylish studio, perfectly in tune with the Neukölln vibe, features a private sunlit terrace. Discover the perfect fusion of comfort, convenience, and cosmopolitan living in your new home.

**APARTMENT**  
Constructed in 2021, this contemporary apartment offers modern amenities and comforts. With floor heating, hardwood oak floors, expansive floor-to-ceiling windows, and lofty 3-meter ceilings, it creates a cozy atmosphere. Spanning 52 square meters, it's an ideal sanctuary for singles or couples seeking serenity. Fully furnished, it caters to your every need, from kitchen essentials to snug bed linens and towels. A dedicated home office space, equipped with fast WiFi, ensures seamless remote work or entertainment.

After a bustling day, unwind on the generous south-facing terrace, soaking in the final rays of sunlight and rejuvenating for the day ahead.

**BUILDING AND OUTDOOR AREA**  
Residents enjoy access to convenient amenities, including an indoor bicycle storage room and outdoor bicycle parking.

**LOCATION**  
Nestled in a peaceful neighborhood, this residence strikes the perfect balance between tranquility and the vibrant heart of the capital. Bergmannkiez, Gräfekiez, Reuterkiez, Friedrichshain – all within easy reach, offering a taste of Berlin's dynamic culture and nightlife.

Schillerkiez, renowned for its proximity to Tempelhofer Feld, alternative vibe, and diverse dining and drinking spots, is a sought-after locale. A leisurely stroll takes you to Volkspark Hasenheide for relaxation, sunbathing, sports, and even a mini zoo.

Grocery shopping is a breeze, with an array of stores just a short walk away. Lidl, Netto, Penny, Eurogida, and Edeka are all within 5-7 minutes, while Rewe and Kaufland are reachable within 10 minutes.

**TRANSPORTATION**  
The M43 bus stop is conveniently located right outside the building.  
The "Boddinstraße" U-Bahn station is a 4-minute walk away.  
The "Hermannstraße" S-Bahn station is only two U-Bahn stops away.  
BER International Airport is a 53-minute journey via U-Bahn and S-Bahn.

title: Görlitzer Straße, Berlin
description:
Beautiful, sunny 3 room apartment directly at the park with great views in the heart of Kreuzberg. The 2nd floor apartment with bright south-facing windows is a typical "Berliner Altbau" from the early 20th century with wooden hard floors, central heating and a spacious, fully equipped kitchen. It has 2 bedrooms: one to the courtyard with a large double bed (180x200), another one to the park with 2 double beds (140x200) - one of which is a loft bed. The south facing living room has a beautiful bay window overlooking the park. The yard is green with a sandpit and trampoline. It is ideal for a couple or family with up to 4 children working from home. 

Görlitzer street is a lovely but still quiet street with great restaurants and trees along the big sidewalk. The U1 subway stations Görlitzer Bahnhof and Schlesisches Tor are nearby 7 minutes walking. The "Wrangel Kiez" offers groceries, organic supermarkets, a post office, bike rentals and all you need for your daily life in walking distance.

The apartment comes with a fully equipped kitchen: new Bosch dishwasher & large refrigerator, Neff induction cooker, Sodastream water sparkler, filter coffee machine & Bialetti espresso maker, complete Zwilling cuttlery for 12 persons, plates, pots and frying pans. A toaster, pepper grinder, sharp knifes, hand mixer and other baking tools. The kitchen is large enough to host a dining table up to 8 people.

The bathroom hosts a Siemens washing machine and a bathtub with shower. There is a hair drier and towels, bed linen and duvets are included for up to 6 people.

There is plenty of storage room, a wardrobe and a custom build shoe rack in the entrance hall. Cleaning tools and a vacuum cleaner.

85 Mbps wifi throughout the apartment and a working desk with paper, pens, scotch tape, scissor and a stapler is provided.

Apart from great views the living room also offers a TV that can be used with your Netflix or Amazon Prime account. There is a HiFi with a vinyl record player in a beautiful wooden bookshelf with books to read in German and English. 

If you come with children there are toys and children books as well as a high chair (2nd one on request).

Rentals of 12 month or longer will have a slightly reduced rate.

title: Weserstraße, Berlin
description:
Bright and Newly Renovated Studio Apartment in Neukölln's Trendiest Neighborhood

This apartment is intended solely for covering a temporary housing need of 3 to approximately 11 months.
The temporary need (such as a study abroad semester, internship, guest professorship, project work, business assignment, trainee program, temporary accommodation due to renovation of your own apartment, etc.) must be proven prior to rental.

Location:
The apartment is located in the heart of the “Weser Kiez,” arguably the most diverse, vibrant, and beautiful neighborhood between Kreuzberg and Neukölln. Weserstraße is known for its variety of restaurants, bars, cafes, and vintage shops.
The apartment is right by the Weigandufer canal, perfect for long walks along the water. Joggers will also love the location, with nature trails along the canal right outside the door.

On the other side, you’ll find the nearby U-Bahn station “Rathaus Neukölln” (U7), offering excellent citywide connections, including a direct line to BER Airport – Berlin Brandenburg (Schönefeld).

Karl-Marx-Straße and Sonnenallee, both within walking distance, offer a wide range of shopping options (Neukölln Arcaden, H&M, Media Markt, Post office, etc.), several cinemas, and countless restaurants.
Tempelhofer Feld – Berlin’s iconic open-air leisure park – and Hasenheide, the city’s own “Central Park,” are both just 10 minutes away.
It’s the perfect mix of peaceful retreat and colorful Berlin authenticity.

Features:
This bright and freshly renovated apartment is ideal for one person or a couple. It is stylishly and uniquely furnished, with plants and thoughtfully chosen furniture.
Fast Wi-Fi (100 Mbps) is included.

The brand-new, fully equipped kitchen includes modern appliances such as a fridge-freezer, ceramic cooktop, oven, and washing machine.
Additional small appliances like a kettle, coffee machine, and food processor are also provided.
Cookware and tableware are, of course, included.

The bathroom features a heated towel rack and shower. Some bath and hand towels are provided.

Comfort Highlights:
• Bright, tastefully decorated apartment in Neukölln’s trendiest location
• New fully equipped kitchen
• High-speed Wi-Fi included
• Free street parking in front of the building (subject to availability)

title: Lausitzer Straße, Berlin
description:
This beautiful 97m2 apartment is in the heart of Kreuzberg's sought-after Reichenberger Kiez, just half a block from the picturesque Landwehr Canal. This exceptional home combines historic Berlin charm with modern luxury in a protected 1888 building that underwent complete high-quality renovation in 2022.

Additional Information

• Spacious front room perfect for living area or home office with direct afternoon sun; equipped with 12-seat table for dining, hosting, or work
• Second living room featuring a comfortable sofa bed (sleeps 2)—ideal for guests
• Tranquil bedroom in the rear of the building with double bed, offering peaceful nights away from street noise
• Custom-designed walk-in closet with abundant storage space and 2.2m clothing rack
• Excellent kitchen with wood and stainless steel finishes, Golem backsplash tiles, AEG induction stove and oven, smoke hood, large Samsung refrigerator, and efficient dishwater; stocked with cookware and tableware
• Fully modernized bathroom with contemporary fixtures by Laufen and Grohe Spa
• Washer + dryer combo in laundry area with storage shelving above
• Original architectural details preserved throughout
• High ceilings (3.5m in front room) and ornate moldings typical of Berlin's grand Gründerzeit buildings
• Privacy-protecting screens, curtains, and soundproofing in front rooms

Location Highlights

Steps from Landwehr Canal for morning runs or evening strolls. Reichenberger Kiez offers the perfect blend of vibrant Kreuzberg culture with tree-lined residential charm. Excellent cafes, restaurants, bars, and shops within walking distance. Great public transport connections: 9 minutes to the U1/U3, 10 minutes to the U8, 4 minutes to the M29.

title: Platanenweg, Berlin
description:
MINIMAL RENTAL PERIOD: 6 MONTHS

Hello everyone, 

this is a fully furnished apartment. The one-room apartment has a comfortable bed, a desk with chair and a wardrobe for your clothes.

Also it is equipped with washing machine, cooking equipment and all you need for your daily living. 

Anmeldung/Registration is possible.

Apartment perfect for 1-2 persons with kitchen.

Apartment has 1 room in total.

At the end of your stay, we will charge a cleaning fee of 50 € which we will deduct from the deposit. The rest will be paid out to you - given that there was no damage done to the apartment.


Location:
You live centrally in the beautiful green area of Treptow on the border to the districts of Friedrichshain and Kreuzberg, not far from the Spree, at the melting pot of the cultural, music, fashion and creative scene.
Whether you are a business traveller, cosmopolitans, international jet-setter or student - here in Plänterwald you will experience Berlin in its natural beauty and how lively and multicultural it is!

Near the apartment, you will find numerous Berlin attractions, such as:
-EastSideGallery - the longest wall gallery in the world
-Simon-Dach-Straße and the Boxhagener-Platz-Kiez
-Berlins most famous bridge - the Oberbaumbrücke,
-Bath and sauna boat and beach bars
-World-famous club culture (e.g. Berghain, Postbahnhof, Fritz-Club, Freischwimmer)
-The "Mercedes Benz Arena", multifunction arena (concerts, sports, Berlin polar bears, Alba)

Excellent public transport links:
-S-Bhf: Plänterwald: S8, S85, S9 (Airport line) by foot
-Shf Ostkreuz: 5 minutes, 2 stations direct
-S3, S41, S42, S5, S7, S75, S8, S85, S9 (Airport Line, 20 minutes to Airport Schönefeld).
Bus: Lines 166, 167, 277, N 65, N 79
-Ship mooring area: Treptower Spreehafen (shipping companies, swimming and sauna ship, etc.)

Distances:
-East Cross “Ostkreuz”: 5 min, 2 stations directly with S3, S41, S42, S5, S7, S75, S8, S85, S9
-East Station “Ostbahnhof”: 11 minutes by the Regional Express RE1, RE2, RE7, RB14, ICE
-Alexanderplatz: 15 min (S-Bahn)
-Main train station: 20 minutes (S-Bahn)
-Humboldt University: 20 min (S-Bahn)
-University of Applied Sciences Berlin: 10 min
-Airport Schönefeld 20 minutes directly with the S-Bahn (S9 = Airport line)

Perfect for persons looking for a modern, centrally located apartment in Berlin! If you have questions or are interested in booking the room feel free to contact me via message.

title: Allerstraße, Berlin
description: Ein WG Zimmer wird angeboten. Bad und Küche sind schon eingerichtet inklusive alle nötigen Möbel im Schlafzimmer wie Bett, Schreibtisch, Schrank etc. Weibliche Mieterinnen werden gesucht. Längerer Aufenthalt ist verhandelbar.

title: Friedrich-Junge-Straße, Berlin
description:
Lovely furnished apartment in a modern building with view to Rummelsburger Bucht. There is a huge open living, dining, kitchen space, one bedroom, a room, that is currently used as an office, but could also be used as a guest room (bed can be added on request) and a bathroom with a huge walk in rain shower. Also there are several balconies and a parking space in the underground garage.
 
Location
The apartment is located in Rummelsburger Bucht, where you can enjoy nice walks by the water. Friedrichshain’s Mediaspree lies in short walking distance. On the other side of River Spree you also find many shops, cafes, restaurants.

title: Donaustraße, Berlin
description:
Das schöne, kürzlich renovierte Apartment in einem historischen Gebäude von 1890 ist mit einer hochwertigen, modernen und komfortablen Einrichtung ausgestattet und bietet ein gemütliches Wohnambiente. Über drei Meter hohe Decken, geschmackvoller Stuck. Blick in einen ruhigen, begrünten Innenhof. Die Zwei-Zimmer-Wohnung verfügt über ein bequemes, 1,40 Meter großes Bett und bietet durch die großen Fenster zum Innenhof einen ruhigen Rückzugsort in zentraler Lage. Das Bad ist mit einer Dusche und eigener Waschmaschine ausgestattet. Der durchdachte Wohn- und Essbereich verfügt über eine voll ausgestattete Küche inklusive eigenem Geschirrspüler, einen Esstisch von 1920 und ein bequemes, neues Ecksofa. Zusätzlich stehen Ihnen ein hochwertiger "The Frame"-Fernseher zur Verfügung, ein Sonos-Soundsystem und kostenloser Wifi-Internetzugang.

Ausstattungsmerkmale: 
- Möblierung und Ausstattung im typischen Berlin-Stil (Midcentury/Vintage)
- Ein separates Schlafzimmer mit Blick in den grünen Innenhof
- Bequemes, modernes Sofa 
- Samsung "The Frame", ein Fernseher, der auch als Kunstwerk fungiert (QLED-Bildqualität, smarte Funktionen)
- Voll ausgestattete, moderne Küche mit Geschirr, Töpfen, Schüsseln, Küchenutensilien etc.  
- Kühlschrank mit Gefrierfach 
- Backofen mit modernem Induktions-Kochfeld 
- Geschirrspüler
- Bialetti-Kaffeemaschine
- HAY-Wasserkocher 
- VITRA-Garderobe
- Handtücher & Bettwäsche 
- Staubsauger / Bügeleisen / Bügelbrett / Wäscheständer / Reinigungsutensilien / Fön
- Kostenloses Internet

Super Lage im hippen Neukölln: viele Restaurants, Bars, Clubs, Kinos in der Nähe. Parks, Grünanlagen, Tempelhofer Feld und Kanal fußläufig erreichbar. U-Bahn-Station "Rathaus Neukölln" direkt um die Ecke (U7/U8).

title: Grimmstraße, Berlin
description:
This stylish 19th-century apartment offers a perfect blend of historic charm and modern amenities. It features original wood flooring, a spacious living area with designer furniture, and a balcony overlooking Grimm Park for a touch of nature. The peaceful bedroom has a luxurious king-size bed, and the fully equipped kitchen includes everything needed for home-cooked meals. With high-speed Wi-Fi, an LED TV, and a beautifully updated bathroom, this apartment is a comfortable and convenient retreat in a quiet, well-connected neighborhood.

Nestled in Berlin’s vibrant Kreuzberg district near Urbanstraße, this apartment places you at the heart of one of the city’s most dynamic neighborhoods. Known for its creative energy and multicultural vibe, Kreuzberg offers a unique mix of trendy cafes, international restaurants, and local markets, all within walking distance. You’ll be close to scenic canal paths, popular parks like Hasenheide, and a short ride from landmarks like Checkpoint Charlie and the East Side Gallery. With excellent public transport connections nearby, you can easily explore the entire city while enjoying the lively, eclectic charm of Kreuzberg.

title: Donaustraße, Berlin
description:
Our 2-room apartment is on 4th floor, it comes with a kitchen and bathroom. It's located in Neukölln, Berlin. 

The apartment has a total surface of 70 m2, suitable for maximum 4 occupants. The building has no lift.
 
The area our lovely apartment locates in is very peaceful and convenient. Nearby you have parks, cafés, and local markets (Market am Maybachufer), giving a “small-town” feel within the capital. From the address is less 30 minutes by car to go to Berlin’s major meeting points like Alexanderplatz, Hauptbahnhof, Zoologischer Garten und Hackescher Market.  From the apartment to:

U-Bahnhof Rathaus Neukölln (U7) – about 3 to 5 minutes walk
U-Bahnhof Karl-Marx-Straße (U7) – about 5 to 7 minutes walk
Sonnenallee station (S41, S42, S45, S46, S47) – about 12 to 15 minutes walk
Travel times from there:
Alexanderplatz – around 15 to 20 minutes (U7 + S-Bahn or U8 connection)
Berlin Hauptbahnhof – around 25 to 30 minutes (with one change)
Zoologischer Garten – around 30 to 35 minutes (U7 direct towards City West)
Hackescher Markt – around 20 to 25 minutes (via Hermannplatz or Alexanderplatz)

The light furnishings and their natural colours give the room’s interior a neat and clean vibe to sooth the traveling feet and soul.

The apartment comes with a brand new white lacquered kitchen with microwave, just need to get the start set of pots and pans ,you will enjoy preparing a gourmet or on the go meals. 

The bathroom is spacious with a shower. A washing machine is available to make your life easier and especially the laundry can be done discretely away from the main living area. Enough space to leave clean linens dry up in the open air using the provided rack.

The apartment offers two queen size bed (140X200 CM), clothes hanger and free wifi (100Mb).

If you book this apartment, the following rules apply:
If your booking start date is between the 1st to the 15th of the month, the full month's rent is due. If your booking start date is between the 16th and the last day of the month, the second half month's rent is due. If your end date of booking is between the 1st to the 15th of the month, the first half month's rent is due. If your end date of booking is between the 16th and the last day of the month, the second half month's rent is due. Smoking is not permitted.

Please Note: The rental deposit is one month's rent: 

- for the WG/ private room: Handover fee 100€  
- for studio /apartment): Handover fee 150€ 

If we accept you as a tenant please deliver the following documents within 7 DAYS: proof of enrolment at your school/university, a bank statement which proves sufficient funds available to pay the rent - a work contract is also suitable.

If we do not receive the documents within 7 days after you have completed the payment we will cancel the booking via HousingAnywhere and claim the first month according to their Terms&Conditions. If the move-in date is within these 7 days we need the documents 24 hours before move-in at the latest 

Before moving in, tenants must provide proof of valid personal liability insurance (“Haftpflichtversicherung”). This insurance covers damages caused to the apartment or to third parties. It is highly recommended in Germany and often included with personal property insurance (“Hausratversicherung”). Without proof of insurance, keys cannot be handed over.

title: Kopfstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to this charming, fully furnished 50 sqm apartment nestled in the vibrant neighbourhood of Neukölln. Located in one of the city's most sought-after areas, this fully furnished, 50 sqm, cozy apartment offers a perfect blend of peace and quiet while living right in the middle of vibrant Neukölln.

The living room has couch and an arm chair for relaxing at the end of the day, hosting friends or watching TV. It also includes a desk and an office chair, along with shelves for books and documents, providing everything you need for working from home.

The kitchen is fully fitted with dishes, cups, glasses, pots and pans and utensils, while still offering plenty of storage space for your own things. It is equipped with an oven and a stove, a fridge and a washing machine.

The bedroom, complete with a cozy double bed, plush bedding, and ample storage space for your belongings. Same as the other rooms, it is well-lit and facing a quiet side street.

Located in the vibrant neighborhood of Neukölln, you'll have a wealth of amenities at your doorstep. Explore the diverse array of trendy cafes, restaurants, and bars that populate the area, offering a wide range of international cuisines and vibrant nightlife. The neighborhood is known for its artistic vibe, with numerous galleries and street art displays to discover.

Public transportation options, including buses and trains, are easily accessible, providing effortless connectivity to other parts of Berlin. Additionally, nearby parks and green spaces offer a peaceful retreat from the urban bustle, perfect for leisurely strolls or picnics on sunny days.

title: Bossestraße, Berlin
description:
This beautiful studio apartment is on the 4th floor of a classic Berlin Altbau building. The building has been renovated in 2024; the inner facade has been done over, the courtyard has been fitted with new bicycle parking, a new area for the bins and greenery. The staircases have been completely renovated and new elevators were built.

Being high up on the 4th floor, and thanks to big modern windows, the apartment has lots of light and air flow.
It offers an excellent layout, in which the kitchen is separated from the living area, and the sleeping area is elegantly separated from the rest of the apartment, to offer privacy.

The modern kitchen includes a fridge, an electric stove and an oven. It is fully equipped with pots, pans, cutlery and silverware, glasses, mugs and everything needed for cooking and dining.

The bathroom has a shower, a toilette and a new washing machine.

There is also a new 50" new smart TV and a comfortable sofa, as well as a small dining area.

A large closet offers plenty of storage space for all your belongings. Additionally, the apartment also has a cellar that belongs to it, to store anything you don't need on a daily basis and so to save space.

title: Schierker Straße, Berlin
description:
It's a 2,5 room apartment. It consist of one living room, one bedroom and also am L shaped kitchen living space. The entire building was modernised 3 years ago. 

It's located between Körner Park and Tempelhofer Feld. Since it's just a five minute walk to S + U Hermannstr you are perfectly connected to all parts of the city. Neukölln is probably the coolest place to be in berlin when it comes to nightlife, art and culture.  

The flat includes modern furniture, high speed internet, (I regularly test the speed and it's around 270 Mbits down and 46 Mbits up with 12ms ping) a ultra short throw project connect to hifi setup and apple TV. 

Kitchen is fully equipped and there is all so a dishwasher, washing machine and dryer.

Perfectly positioned between the Landwehr Canal and Hasenheide Park, it combines the best of city living with a touch of nature.
Located in a beautifully preserved historic building, the apartment features high ceilings, large windows, and a bright, airy atmosphere. The tranquil courtyard ensures privacy and quiet, while just outside, the vibrant streets of Graefekiez invite you to explore its cozy cafés, boutique shops, and diverse restaurants.

The apartment is furnished and decorated with taste and plenty of nice details, fitted with parquet flooring using genuine wood; there is a modern fitted kitchen. Branded products have been used exclusively for sanitary items and fittings.
The living room area is furnished with a double bed, sofa, chest of drawers, table and 2 chairs and television. The kitchen is furnished with all things that are necessary for cooking and eating, fridge/freezer, gas stove with 4 plates and oven.

Graefekiez is one of Kreuzberg’s most charming and livable neighborhoods, full of tiny cafes, plant stores, candy shops, record stores, pizza shops and bars in a cosy, tree-lined area with a feeling very much geared to outdoor living, offering a perfect mix of green spaces, culinary delights, and convenient amenities. Situated between the Landwehr Canal and Hasenheide Park, this area provides both a relaxed atmosphere and easy access to everything you need.

Cafés, Bars & Restaurants
Graefekiez is known for its cozy cafés, vibrant bars, and diverse restaurants. Whether you’re looking for specialty coffee, organic brunch spots, or international cuisine, you’ll find plenty of options. Some local favorites include:
Ankerklause – A legendary bar right by the canal, perfect for drinks with a view.
Zazza – A popular café serving excellent coffee and pastries.
Barcomi’s – A beloved spot for cakes and bagels.
Cocolo Ramen – Famous for its authentic Japanese ramen.
Volk – A cozy wine bar with a great selection of natural wines.
At night, the area comes alive with laid-back bars and pubs, many of which have a strong local following.

Supermarkets & Markets
For daily shopping, Graefekiez offers a variety of supermarkets and independent stores:
Edeka & Bio Company – Well-stocked for everyday groceries and organic products.
Türkish markets & specialty stores – Great for fresh produce, spices, and international goods.
Maybachufer Market (Türkenmarkt) – A lively weekly market along the canal offering fresh fruits, vegetables, cheese, and street food.

Public Transportation
Graefekiez is well connected to the rest of Berlin with several public transport options:
U-Bahn stations: Schönleinstraße (U8) and Südstern (U7), providing fast connections to Mitte, Neukölln, and Charlottenburg.
Bus lines: Multiple bus routes ensure easy access to other districts.
Cycling & Walking: The neighborhood is bike-friendly, with dedicated cycling paths along the canal and quiet side streets perfect for walking.

With its lively yet relaxed atmosphere, excellent amenities, and easy transport links, Graefekiez is one of Berlin’s most desirable places to live. Whether you're grabbing a coffee by the canal, shopping at the market, or enjoying a quiet evening in a courtyard café, this neighborhood offers the perfect mix of urban charm and tranquility.

/// THE DISTRICT ///

Nestled in the heart of Kreuzberg, Wrangelkiez is one of Berlin’s most vibrant and characterful neighborhoods. Once known as Kreuzberg 36 for being the district around the Berlin wall, now this part of Kreuzberg is known for its rich history, multicultural atmosphere, and thriving creative scene, this area embodies the dynamic spirit of the city.
Bordered by the Spree River and Görlitzer Park, Wrangelkiez offers the perfect balance of green spaces and urban energy. Its streets are lined with independent cafés, bars, galleries, and international eateries, reflecting the neighborhood’s diverse community. From legendary nightlife spots to cozy local bakeries, every corner of Wrangelkiez has a story to tell.

Wrangelkiez is not only one of Berlin’s most vibrant neighborhoods but also a highly convenient place to live, thanks to its excellent access to supermarkets and public transportation.
For daily grocery shopping, residents have a mix of large supermarkets and small local stores to choose from. Well-known chains like Edeka, Lidl, and Bio Company offer a wide range of products, while independent organic shops and Turkish grocery stores provide fresh produce, spices, and specialty goods.

When it comes to public transportation, Wrangelkiez is well connected to the rest of Berlin. The U1 and U3 subway lines at Schlesisches Tor provide quick access to Friedrichshain, Mitte, and Charlottenburg. The U-Bahn station Görlitzer Bahnhof (U1, U3) is another key stop in the area. Numerous bus and tram lines, including the M29, 165, and 265, offer reliable connections to other districts, making it easy to get around without a car. Additionally, cyclists benefit from well-developed bike lanes and easy access to Berlin’s bike-sharing services.
With its mix of convenient shopping options and excellent public transport links, Wrangelkiez is as practical as it is lively, making it a great place to live for both newcomers and longtime Berliners.

title: Jansastraße, Berlin
description:
HOUSE
The apartment is located on the 4th floor of a typical Berlin Altbau.

APARTMENT
Available from Autumn 2025, this beautifully renovated and fully furnished apartment offers everything you need for modern, comfortable living in one of Berlin’s most vibrant neighborhoods.
The bright and spacious living room is designed for both relaxation and productivity. Unwind on the large, cozy sofa while streaming your favorite shows on the smart TV, or make use of the quiet desk space for focused work.
The sleek, fully equipped kitchen includes a large fridge with freezer, dishwasher, coffee machine, kettle, and all necessary cookware, utensils, and tableware. A dining table for two creates the perfect setting for meals at home.
In the charming bedroom, a comfortable queen-size bed and a custom-built wardrobe provide both rest and ample storage.
The modern bathroom completes the home with a bathtub: ideal for a relaxing soak after a long day.

++ “Anmeldung” is possible.
++ High Speed Internet (100mbit/s) is available.

AREA
Located on Jansastraße, the apartment puts you right in the middle of everything that makes Neukölln so loved. Within a few minutes’ walk, you’ll find grocery stores, bakeries, and fresh produce markets, including the beloved Turkish market at Maybachufer, open twice a week and full of street food and local color. For coffee lovers, there’s no shortage of cozy cafés nearby, perfect for working remotely or catching up with friends.
Dining options are endless: hip vegetarian bistros and refined European cuisine, everything is just around the corner. Whether you’re craving street food or fine dining, you’ll find something that suits your taste.
For green spaces, you’re just a short stroll from Körnerpark, a peaceful, elegant garden with fountains and a café. A bit further, Volkspark Hasenheide offers larger grounds for jogging, relaxing, or catching an open-air film in the summer.
Art and culture are also close at hand: Heimathafen Neukölln hosts concerts, theater, and spoken word events, while the nearby streets are full of galleries, street art, and unique vintage shops that capture the creative spirit of the neighborhood.
Public transport is easily accessible, connecting you to the rest of Berlin in no time. Still, with so much right outside your door, you may not want to leave the neighborhood at all.

# The Apartment
The apartment is located in beautiful Neukölln in a quiet location, only a few minutes walk from the Maybach Ufer/Landwehr Canal, around local cafes, restaurants and shops.

This is an accessible apartment on the ground floor in the rear building: there is a small step up to enter the building and a small step down to enter the apartment. There is a dedicated space for strollers, wheelchairs and bikes, at the entrance to the apartment as well as in the yard.

 It is bright, has wooden floors and is modern and timelessly furnished, with a private garden in the common yard area.

The apartment is located in the district Neukölln, at the border to Kreuzberg, only a few minutes to the canal and the popular Maybachufer/Landwehr Canal and directly at the Reuterplatz. Quiet, green, beautiful shops and cafés and hip Berlin charm wherever you look.
Schönleinstr underground is only 5 minutes away, Hermannplatz is 10 minutes by foot.

title: Elsenstraße, Berlin
description:
Schöne und komplett möblierte Wohnung in Alt-Treptow mit hochwertiger Ausstattung. Dieses charmant eingerichtete Apartment verfügt über ein Schlafzimmer und einen schön gestalteten Wohnbereich mit großem Sofa und Fernseher. 

Eine voll ausgestattete Küche mit Herd, Kühl-/Gefrierschrank, Waschmaschine und Backofen und einer separaten Sitzecke mit direkten Balkonzugang machen die Wohnung direkt startbereit. Außerdem bietet es ein schönes Badezimmer mit Badewanne. Die Wohnung liegt zentral, umgeben von Cafés, Restaurants, Geschäften und Bioläden. Perfekt für Paare oder Geschäftsleute, die in Berlin tätig sind.

Die Lage ist super: Ob Alexanderplatz, Ostbahnhof, das Spreeufer oder der grüne Treptower Park - alles ist von hier sehr gut erreichbar.

Nur in wenigen Schritten ist man aus der verkehrsberuhigten Lage mitten im lebendigen Berlin, mit seinen Bars und Cafés, Galerien und Kunsthäusern.

Ein Stadtviertel für echte Berliner und jene die es werden wollen!

title: Schierker Straße, Berlin
description:
Schönes, voll ausgestattetes und möbliertes Apartment in zentraler Lage im Südwesten Berlins.

Charmant geschnitten verfügt diese Wohnung über einen hellen Wohnbereich mit allem, was man braucht - liebevoll mit einem Sofa, TV Set und Esstisch eingerichtet. Das Apartment punktet mit einem Balkon am Wohnzimmer.

Gegenüber befindet sich das Schlafzimmer mit einem Doppelbett und Einbauschrank.
Daneben liegt die ausgestattete Küche mit Induktionsherd,  Kühl- und Gefrierschrank, Ofen und Geschirrspüler. 

Zusätzlich bietet es ein gefliestes Bad. 
Im Flur befindet sich eine Garderobe.

Die Wohnung liegt zentral, unweit des Schillerkiez und umgeben von Cafés, Restaurants, Einkaufs- und Bioläden. Perfekt für ein Paar oder Businessleute, die geschäftlich in Berlin tätig sind.

title: Stralauer Allee, Berlin
description:
Diese charmante und sehr gepflegte Wohnung ist ideal für alle, die ein gemütliches und stilvolles Zuhause in hervorragender Lage suchen. Sie ist zwar kompakt, aber durchdacht geschnitten und optimal genutzt.

Das helle Schlafzimmer bietet nicht nur einen angenehmen Schlafbereich, sondern auch einen Esstisch – perfekt zum Entspannen und für den Alltag. In einem separaten Raum, durch eine Tür abgetrennt, befindet sich die kleine, aber voll ausgestattete Küche mit Herd, Mikrowelle, Spüle und Waschmaschine. Der Boden in der Küche hat ein parkettähnliches Design und verleiht dem Raum eine wohnliche Atmosphäre.

Ein Highlight der Wohnung ist das moderne Badezimmer mit weißen Wandfliesen, schwarzen Bodenfliesen und einer Badewanne mit beweglicher Glasabtrennung – praktisch und stilvoll zugleich.

Hochwertiger Holzboden im Flur und im Schlafzimmer rundet das wohnliche Gesamtbild ab. Eine kleine Wohnung mit großem Charme – funktional, gepflegt und in einer wunderschönen Umgebung gelegen.
Diese charmante Wohnung in der Stralauer Allee vereint städtischen Komfort mit der ruhigen Atmosphäre des Lebens am Wasser.

Nur wenige Schritte von der Spree entfernt, bietet die Wohnung eine ideale Mischung aus Ruhe und urbanem Flair. Die Umgebung begeistert mit angesagten Cafés, vielfältigen Restaurants und kulturellen Highlights. Ob ein entspannter Morgenkaffee am Wasser oder ein Dinner in einem der trendigen Lokale – alles liegt direkt vor Ihrer Haustür.

title: Schönleinstraße, Berlin
description:
Stunning Apartment with Everything You Need! 🌟🏠

Discover this stylishly furnished apartment located at Schönleinstraße, Berlin, Germany, situated on the 2nd floor of a residential building. With a living space of approximately 45 sqm, this apartment is designed for comfort and convenience, perfect for couples.

The living and sleeping areas feature light carpeting, while the bathroom and kitchen are tiled. The spacious living room is furnished with a comfortable sofa, armchair, and a small glass coffee table, creating a cozy atmosphere bathed in natural light from the many windows 🛋️🌞. Decorations, paintings, and plants add to the homely feel, ensuring you'll feel comfortable and relaxed in no time 🌿🖼️.

The separate sleeping area boasts a large double bed built as a loft, accessible via practical stairs. This space-saving design allows for additional armchairs and closets underneath, providing ample storage for both tenants' belongings 🛏️👚.

The separate kitchen is fully equipped with a refrigerator, stove with oven, toaster, kettle, microwave, coffee maker, and all necessary cutlery and dishes 🍽️☕.

The bathroom features a shower, toilet, mirror, sink, and includes towels and a hairdryer for your convenience. Additionally, a washing machine is available for the tenant's use within the apartment 🚿🧴.

Centrally located in the beautiful Kreuzberg district, this apartment offers easy access to public transportation 🚇. The bus stop "Hohenstaufenplatz" is just 270 meters away, and the subway station "U Schönleinstr." is a short 4-minute walk (350 meters) 🚌. Supermarkets such as EDEKA and Netto are conveniently within a 5-minute walk, ensuring all your daily needs are met 🛒.

Experience the vibrant lifestyle of Kreuzberg in this stunning and well-equipped apartment! 💖🏙️✨

title: Sonnenallee, Berlin
description:
Du teilst Dir die Wohnung mit 3 anderen Mitbewohnern. Dein Zimmer besteht aus 2 miteinander verbundenen Räumen, die durch eine Tür voneinander getrennt sind. Davon ist ein Raum schallgedämmt und eignet sich besonders zum Schlafen und zum Musik machen. Eine Besonderheit dieses Zimmers sind die Ablageflächen sowie der grosszügige Stauraum (ca 120x150cm) über dem Bett, wo auch schwere Koffer untergebracht werden können. Ansonsten besteht die Wohnung aus 4 Zimmern, Küche und Bad und Flur sowie einer Abstellkammer. Die Wohnung befindet sich in zentraler Lage in "Kreuzkölln" umgeben von von zahlreichen Restaurants und Einkaufsmöglichkeiten, 100m entfernt vom Herrmannplatz, 2 U-Bahn-Linien und viele Buslinien erlauben hohe Mobilität zu jeder Tages- und Nachtzeit auch ohne Auto. Wollt ihr zu  zweit einziehen, so erhöht sich die Miete um 150 € wegen Mehrkosten für Strom, Wasser, Gas

title: Müllenhoffstraße, Berlin
description:
Beautiful, newly renovated apartment right in the heart of Berlin’s most exciting neighbourhood. 

This apartment is fully furnished and equipped with several amenities, including a washing machine. The property has a spacious living room with plenty of natural light and a balcony looking out onto the peaceful Kreuzkoln streets. Perfect for singles or couples, with extra space for entertaining and real wooden floors and gas heating. 

The local area offers the best Berlin has to offer. The apartment is surrounded by green spaces, cool cafes, and restaurants, and is a 3-minute walk from the Landwehr Canal. The closest bus stop is less than five minutes away and within fifteen minutes you can find yourself in the historic area of Kottbusser Tor. 

Link to 3d tour: https://my.matterport.com/show/?m=AHo5YWvwGAk

The apartment includes:
-Elevator
-Fully accessorised kitchen
-Washing machine
-High speed WiFi
-TV, 55 inches with soundbar.
-Electricity, heating and utilities included in rent
-Registration (Anmeldung) possible 

🔸The deposit has to be paid fully and directly to us before the move-in date
❌Bed and bath textiles are not provided and have to be organised by the tenant

Please note: The advertised cleaning fee is an average estimate and may vary depending on the condition of the apartment. If the apartment is returned in a clean state, the fee may be reduced or even waived entirely. If the condition is worse, the fee may be increased.

title: Kiefholzstraße, Berlin
description:
Modern living: These innovative concept flats in the intersection of the trend districts Kreuzberg, Friedrichshain and Neukölln in Berlin Alt-Treptow. Modern, minimalist, stylish, functional – and right in the middle of the action.


How is the commute from here to other locations?
The quiet Kiefholzstraße 22 (30 kmh zone) is the perfect base to explore Berlin. Several bus and train lines in the vicinity take you easily to the main railway station (Hauptbahnhof), Berlin Mitte, Friedrichshain, Neukölln, Kreuzberg, Hackescher Markt, Alexanderplatz, Wrangelkiez, Reuterkiez, Osthafen and Boxhagener Kiez. Life couldn’t be better. In addition, there is a top connection to the new BER airport, a connection to the circular railway and soon to the city motorway via the new motorway junction at Treptower Park (completion approx. 2022).

S+U Bahn Warschauer Straße: 8 min. by bike
S-Treptower Park: 4 min. by bike 
Supermarkt: across the street

Does it have parking space?
The car can be parked on the street, but parking fees apply. A resident parking vignette can be requested after registration.

How big is the apartment?
It is a beautiful studio apartmnet, with an open kitchen, bathroom and a balcony or trerrace.

Why Choose this apartment?
The studio kitchens offer everything you need in everyday life: a built-in microwave with grill function, an undermounted refrigerator, a small induction hob, stainless steel fittings, a quartz stone worktop, LED lighting and optimally planned upperboards with many storage options for crockery, cutlery and kitchen utensils. A wardrobe is in the apartment. A full bathroom is also integrated into every flat. With brand name bathroom furnishings, towel radiators and a state-of-the-art ventilation system. 

Overview
The well planned single flats for discerning urban dwellers. For creative people and visionaries who want to live on the cutting edge and in the middle of one of the most exciting cities of all. The flats  are impressive thanks to their smart room layout and flexible elements, a reduced design, balcony, floor-to-ceiling windows, oak parquet, underfloor heating, first-rate designer kitchens and brand-name bathroom furnishings. The Trepower Park is the second largest park in Berlin and is only 750 m away from your flat. There you can do water activities like canoeing, tubing or pedal boating, go jogging or walking, have a drink in one of the restaurants, or just hang out and chill in the sun. On the way is the Park Center Treptow (shopping centre) with its shops and shopping opportunities. After a 4 minute bike ride you are in the hippest part of Kreuzberg with its restaurants, bars and clubs and you have the opportunity to feel the vibrant pulse of the city.


Amenities & Furniture:
Elevator, Cellar, Energy Certificate, Commission Free, Balcony, Shower, Parquet Floor, Floor heating, New Construction, Shower, Mirror, Wardrobe, Induction Stove, Fitted kitchen, Refrigerator, Microwave

1) The contract can start on any date, and the rent will be calculated on a daily pro-rata basis.
2) Our contract charges are calculated on a daily pro-rata basis. This means your rent will be based only on the exact number of days from your move-in date.
3) Once the booking is confirmed and all documents are received, we  will send you a rental contract via email and You need to sign it & send it back to me within 48hours.
4) Registration possible and the necessary document will be provided post the move-in
5) The check in can only take place Monday to Friday 9 am until 6 pm. Check in on the weekends or national holidays would be possible upon request for a small fee of 100€
6) Liability insurance is required for your stay and that needs to be submitted to us within 15 days from your move in date.. We recommend you to search for one yourself with a keyword “Haftpflichtversicherung“
7) Final cleaning fee: 200 €
8) 7% Surcharge is applicable for short-lets (duration of less than 6 months)
9) For rental durations of more than six months, the deposit can be paid in three installments.
10) Seurity deposit amount needs to be paid before the move-in date

title: Urbanstraße, Berlin

The five-storey house was built around 1910 and modified and refurbished to Bel Village standards in 2017. There are 25 one- and two-bedroom flats in the house. Furnished single flats with individual design furnishings:

- Bed incl. bed linen
- wardrobe

- WLAN internet
- Smart TV
- Bluetooth sound system
- Ambient Light

- Modern bathroom (with shower)

title: Braunschweiger Straße, Berlin
description:
Willkommen in Ihrem neuen Zuhause in der Braunschweiger Straße, einem charmanten und gut angebundenen Wohnviertel im aufstrebenden Bezirk Neukölln! Dieses geschmackvoll möblierte Apartment bietet Ihnen eine komfortable Unterkunft mit modernem Flair und Zugang zu allem, was die aufregende Hauptstadt zu bieten hat.

Die Braunschweiger Straße liegt in einem der lebendigsten und vielfältigsten Viertel Berlins. Neukölln ist bekannt für seine multikulturelle Atmosphäre, kreative Szene und das pulsierende Stadtleben. Direkt vor Ihrer Haustür finden Sie eine Vielzahl an Cafés, Restaurants und Bars, die eine breite Palette an internationalen Küchen und gemütlichen Treffpunkten bieten. 

Für Naturliebhaber und Freizeitsportler bietet die Nähe zum Volkspark Hasenheide und dem Tempelhofer Feld eine willkommene Abwechslung. Der Volkspark Hasenheide ist ideal für Spaziergänge, Picknicks und sportliche Aktivitäten, während das Tempelhofer Feld, das ehemalige Flughafengelände, eine einzigartige Freifläche für Jogger, Radfahrer und Kite-Surfer bietet.

Die kulturelle Szene in Neukölln ist ebenso vielfältig wie die gastronomische. Besuchen Sie die zahlreichen Galerien, Ateliers und Kunsträume, die das Viertel prägen, oder genießen Sie ein Konzert oder eine Theateraufführung im Heimathafen Neukölln. Die Nähe zur Neuköllner Oper und anderen Kulturstätten macht die Gegend besonders attraktiv für Kunst- und Kulturliebhaber.

Dank der hervorragenden Verkehrsanbindung sind Sie bestens vernetzt. Die U- und S-Bahn-Station Neukölln sowie mehrere Buslinien sind nur wenige Gehminuten entfernt und bieten schnelle Verbindungen in alle Teile Berlins. Ob Sie zur Arbeit pendeln oder die vielen Sehenswürdigkeiten der Stadt erkunden möchten – von hier aus gelangen Sie bequem und schnell zu Ihrem Ziel.

Das Apartment selbst ist ein wahres Schmuckstück. Es besticht durch seine moderne Einrichtung und hochwertige Ausstattung. Die voll ausgestattete Küche lädt zu kulinarischen Experimenten ein, während der helle und großzügige Wohnbereich der ideale Ort zum Entspannen ist. Große Fenster sorgen für viel Tageslicht und eine angenehme Atmosphäre.

Erleben Sie Berlin in all seiner Vielfalt und Dynamik von Ihrem neuen möblierten Apartment in der Braunschweiger Straße aus. Hier verbinden sich urbaner Lebensstil und komfortables Wohnen zu einem einzigartigen Wohnerlebnis – perfekt für jeden, der die aufregende Hauptstadt in vollen Zügen genießen möchte.

Englisch:
Welcome to your new home on Braunschweiger Straße, a charming and well-connected residential neighborhood in the up-and-coming district of Neukölln! This tastefully furnished apartment offers you comfortable accommodation with a modern flair and access to everything the exciting capital has to offer.

Braunschweiger Straße is located in one of Berlin’s most vibrant and diverse neighborhoods. Neukölln is known for its multicultural atmosphere, creative scene, and bustling city life. Right outside your door, you'll find a variety of cafes, restaurants, and bars offering a wide range of international cuisines and cozy meeting spots. Enjoy the culinary delights and relaxed atmosphere in the many establishments around the lively Hermannplatz.

For nature lovers and fitness enthusiasts, the proximity to Volkspark Hasenheide and Tempelhofer Feld provides a welcome change of pace. Volkspark Hasenheide is perfect for walks, picnics, and sports activities, while Tempelhofer Feld, the former airport site, offers a unique open space for joggers, cyclists, and kite surfers.

The cultural scene in Neukölln is as diverse as its culinary offerings. Visit the numerous galleries, studios, and art spaces that define the neighborhood, or enjoy a concert or theater performance at Heimathafen Neukölln. The proximity to Neuköllner Oper and other cultural venues makes the area especially attractive for art and culture enthusiasts.

Thanks to excellent public transportation connections, you are well connected. The Neukölln U-Bahn and S-Bahn stations, as well as several bus lines, are just a few minutes' walk away and provide quick connections to all parts of Berlin. Whether you are commuting to work or exploring the many sights of the city, you can easily and quickly reach your destination from here.
The apartment itself is a true gem. It features modern furnishings and high-quality amenities. The fully equipped kitchen invites you to culinary experiments, while the bright and spacious living area is the ideal place to relax. Large windows provide plenty of daylight and a pleasant atmosphere.

Experience Berlin in all its diversity and dynamism from your new furnished apartment on Braunschweiger Straße. Here, urban lifestyle and comfortable living combine to create a unique living experience – perfect for anyone who wants to fully enjoy the exciting capital.

We’re excited to offer a bright and fully furnished room (Room 3) in a shared apartment on the 2nd floor. The room is equipped with a comfortable bed, desk, chair, and wardrobe – ideal for studying, working, or simply relaxing.

The apartment includes shared access to the kitchen and bathroom, which are fully equipped with all essentials, including kitchen supplies and a washing machine.

📍 Registration (Anmeldung) is possible, making it suitable for both students and professionals staying longer term in the city.
💰 The monthly rent is all-inclusive, covering rent, heating, water, high-speed internet, and the GEZ TV license fee.
🗓️ Move-in dates are available on the 1st or 16th of each month, with some flexibility if needed.
🔐 A security deposit of €950 is required before moving in.

Please be aware that HousingAnywhere is an online booking platform, so we cannot offer in-person viewings or exchange direct contact information. If you’re interested, simply send us a message or booking request and let us know your age and occupation.

We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Hermannstraße, Berlin

Nestled within the bustling cityscape of Berlin, Biebricher Straße emerges as a hidden gem that offers a serene retreat from the urban commotion. Situated in the vibrant district of Kreuzberg, this street embodies a distinct ambiance of calm and contemplation, inviting wanderers to escape the city's clamor.

As one ambles along Biebricher Straße, an immediate sense of departure from the urban frenzy envelops the senses. The street's character is painted by its charming cobblestone paths and leafy trees, forming an oasis of tranquility amidst the concrete and metal that typify Berlin's architecture.

Unlike the more frenetic avenues, Biebricher Straße embraces a leisurely pace. Its ambiance is a harmonious blend of introspection and exploration. The street's narrow sidewalks are adorned with eclectic boutiques, local cafes, and antique shops that evoke an old-world charm. This tapestry of offerings encourages unhurried strolls and unhindered connection with the surroundings.

Biebricher Straße draws from the rich history of Kreuzberg, a district that has transformed from an industrial hub to a melting pot of cultures. The street encapsulates this narrative through its architecture—a mixture of centuries-old buildings and contemporary residences. The architectural diversity creates a unique setting where the past coexists with the present.

Beyond its architectural tale, Biebricher Straße aligns with Kreuzberg's reputation for embracing alternative scenes. The street fosters a connection to the artistic soul of the district, with galleries and creative spaces that exhibit the talents of local artists. This artistic resonance creates an ambiance that is both reflective and inspirational.

While the street exudes a serene aura, it remains well-connected to the city's rhythms. Public transportation options are within reach, ensuring that Biebricher Straße maintains its serene identity without severing ties to the larger urban tapestry.

As the sun dips beneath the horizon, Biebricher Straße assumes a different hue. The soft glow of streetlights illuminates the path, and the street's cafes and eateries take on a cozy allure. This transformation mirrors Kreuzberg's duality—a district that balances the lively and the serene in seamless harmony.

In essence, Biebricher Straße stands as a sanctuary within Kreuzberg's energetic embrace. It offers a momentary escape, inviting you to disconnect from the city's hustle and engage in a dialogue with your surroundings. Whether you're a leisure seeker, a history enthusiast, or an appreciator of the arts, Biebricher Straße promises an enriching journey through the layers of Berlin's soul.

description:
Welcome to the heart of the city! The apartment is in a great location and offers you everything you need for a great stay in this city! The location of the property offers everything your heart desires. Quiet living, work and leisure come together here. Everything you need for daily life is in the immediate vicinity. The apartment offers you many advantages for a pleasant stay. See for yourself. Here you will feel like in your second home.

This fabulous 2,5-room apartment offers a spacious 68 qm with high ceiling as well as wodden flooring and a sunny and enhancing balcony. The accommodation is located in the scene district Neukölln - more central than this location you cannot find! This enjoyable area offers supermarkets, restaurants and bars in abundance.

Public transportation near by so that you can reach any part of Berlin in no time. Spacious kitchen and bathroom for the ultimate feelgood experience. This flat is fully equipped with wasching maschine, a kitchen that leaves no wish unanswered plus all neccessary things for bedroom. The extras of very strong internet, electricity, heating and water consumption are included in the monthly rent - no hidden or additional costs.

•      final Inspection fee paid at Move out of 150EURs

Nestled within the bustling cityscape of Berlin, Biebricher Straße emerges as a hidden gem that offers a serene retreat from the urban commotion. Situated in the vibrant district of Kreuzberg, this street embodies a distinct ambiance of calm and contemplation, inviting wanderers to escape the city's clamor.

As one ambles along Biebricher Straße, an immediate sense of departure from the urban frenzy envelops the senses. The street's character is painted by its charming cobblestone paths and leafy trees, forming an oasis of tranquility amidst the concrete and metal that typify Berlin's architecture.

Unlike the more frenetic avenues, Biebricher Straße embraces a leisurely pace. Its ambiance is a harmonious blend of introspection and exploration. The street's narrow sidewalks are adorned with eclectic boutiques, local cafes, and antique shops that evoke an old-world charm. This tapestry of offerings encourages unhurried strolls and unhindered connection with the surroundings.

Biebricher Straße draws from the rich history of Kreuzberg, a district that has transformed from an industrial hub to a melting pot of cultures. The street encapsulates this narrative through its architecture—a mixture of centuries-old buildings and contemporary residences. The architectural diversity creates a unique setting where the past coexists with the present.

Beyond its architectural tale, Biebricher Straße aligns with Kreuzberg's reputation for embracing alternative scenes. The street fosters a connection to the artistic soul of the district, with galleries and creative spaces that exhibit the talents of local artists. This artistic resonance creates an ambiance that is both reflective and inspirational.

While the street exudes a serene aura, it remains well-connected to the city's rhythms. Public transportation options are within reach, ensuring that Biebricher Straße maintains its serene identity without severing ties to the larger urban tapestry.

As the sun dips beneath the horizon, Biebricher Straße assumes a different hue. The soft glow of streetlights illuminates the path, and the street's cafes and eateries take on a cozy allure. This transformation mirrors Kreuzberg's duality—a district that balances the lively and the serene in seamless harmony.

In essence, Biebricher Straße stands as a sanctuary within Kreuzberg's energetic embrace. It offers a momentary escape, inviting you to disconnect from the city's hustle and engage in a dialogue with your surroundings. Whether you're a leisure seeker, a history enthusiast, or an appreciator of the arts, Biebricher Straße promises an enriching journey through the layers of Berlin's soul.

title: Falckensteinstraße, Berlin
description:
PLEASE NOTE THAT IF YOU RENT THE ACCOMMODATION FOR LESS THAN 6 MONTHS, THE RENTAL PRICE INCREASES BY 7%.

The freshly renovated apartment features a radiant, modern interior and the high-quality furnishings ensure a particularly cozy living experience. VIEWING POSSIBLE



This 85m2 designer apartment leaves nothing to be desired. 
The bright and high quality furnished 4-room apartment with 3 cozy bedrooms, each with a comfortable king size double box spring bed. 
The bathroom is equipped with a large shower and the living and dining area impresses with a large, modern kitchen, a dining table for up to 6 people and a comfortable couch, which invites you to cozy TV evenings with loved ones.
The entire apartment was furnished in a modern, as well as cozy style. 
Furthermore, a modern smart TV, which is Netflix and Amazon Prime capable, a Sonos sound system and a free wireless internet access with flat rate are available.
You can easily wash and dry your clothes directly in the bathroom with a modern washer-dryer.               


Equipment features:

Furnishing and equipment by professional interior designer
Box spring bed
Fully equipped, modern kitchen with dishes, pots, bowls, kitchen utensils etc. 
Refrigerator with freezer compartment
Oven
Modern ceramic hob
Dishwasher
Nespresso coffee machine, microwave, toaster & kettle 
High quality towels & bed linen 
Hoover / iron / ironing board / clothes horse / cleaning utensils / hairdryer
Free internet 
Smart TV with Netflix and Amazon Prime function
Sonos sound system



Surroundings:
The apartment is located in an absolute prime location in the so-called Wrangelkiez, in the Berlin district of Kreuzberg (Friedrichshain-Kreuzberg district). The Wrangelkiez allows you to really experience the Berlin flair through countless cafes, restaurants, bars and clubs and become part of the lively city center. You are literally surrounded by buses and trains, so you can travel through Berlin flawlessly and especially quickly. Within only 5 minutes walking distance you can reach the subway station "Schlesisches Tor" and countless bus lines, so you still have your peace and quiet.
A Rewe is located right on your street corner, which means you almost only have to walk down your stairs and you can easily buy necessary groceries. In less than 10 minutes walk you can even go to the popular Markthalle Neun to buy various super fresh food and more (household items, flowers, etc.).
If you still just want to take a walk in nature, the lively Görlitzer Park is also only 2 min walk away.
All around you are provided with everything within walking distance.




Distances:

1 min walk to supermarkets
2 min walk to Lukas pharmacy 
2 min. walking distance to Görlitzer Park
4 min. walk to "Falkensteinstr." (bus)
5 min. walk to subway station "Schlesisches Tor
10 min walk to Markthalle Neun
10 min drive to the hospital "Vivantes Klinikum Am Urban

About Berlin 

Step into Berlin – a pulsating city steeped in history, teeming with creativity, and offering a universe of possibilities. Nestled at the heart of Europe, Berlin extends an irresistible blend of dynamic culture, architectural wonders, and narratives waiting to be unveiled. As you contemplate your upcoming residence in this thriving metropolis, allow us to offer you a tantalizing glimpse into life in Berlin.
Explore a metropolis where antiquity and modernity coalesce seamlessly. From the iconic Brandenburg Gate to the avant-garde structures of Potsdamer Platz, Berlin's architecture narrates tales of its diverse past and the ongoing evolution of its present. Meander through the picturesque cobblestone pathways of Mitte, where galleries, boutiques, and cafés beckon you to immerse yourself in the city's artistic heartbeat.

Berlin's reputation as a cultural haven precedes it. Encompassing world-class museums and galleries like the Pergamon Museum and the East Side Gallery, the city ardently preserves its historical legacy while exulting in its innovative spirit. The medley of culinary delights – from traditional German sausages to pioneering vegan indulgences – mirrors Berlin's ethos of open-mindedness and inclusivity.

Navigating the city is a breeze, thanks to its impeccable connectivity. The efficient public transportation network facilitates exploration of every nook, from the historical allure of Charlottenburg to the edgy charisma of Friedrichshain. Enjoy a leisurely bike ride along the tranquil Spree River or effortlessly traverse neighborhoods via the U-Bahn.

The heart and soul of Berlin resides in its people. The locals, renowned for their warmth and hospitality, welcome newcomers with arms wide open. Engage in spirited dialogues at local beer gardens, partake in community galas within sprawling parks like Tiergarten, and submerge yourself in the city's vibrant nightlife – ranging from intimate jazz enclaves to throbbing techno sanctuaries.

Berlin's allure extends to history buffs, culture aficionados, and seekers of a vibrant lifestyle alike. As you contemplate embracing this city as your own, envisage your role within its narrative – a narrative that champions diversity, innovation, and an unceasing spirit of renaissance. Your voyage in Berlin is on the brink of commencement, and your fresh odyssey promises to be nothing short of extraordinary.

WHO WE ARE:
We are a start-up committed to solely hosting ambitious successful young professionals aged 21-35. We believe that hosting like-minded go-getters is essential for a pleasant flat atmosphere. With your relocation to Berlin to one of our luxurious co-living spaces, you will get direct access to an elite community of carefully selected individuals. You will instantly be integrated in Berlin ́s social circle of bright rainmakers.

Renting a room with us can be compared to joining a selective membership club. Ultimately, our mission is to provide aspiring personalities like you, who are newly drawn to Berlin, with prompt communal cohesion and moreover with an extensive network of thriving achievers. Not just within your own co-living space, but also beyond your flat. On a periodical basis, we organize events, where tenants from different co-living spaces come together to enjoy an exciting evening and are moreover given a platform to network and bond. These events can be in form of fancy restaurant dinners, exclusive catered house-parties, long weekend lunches or even personalized pub crawls. Of course, with pleasure, we carry all costs of our highly valued get-togethers.

Regarding living comfort, we have established a new level of luxury in the co-living space segment. All our flats are equipped with the finest furniture highlighted by kingsized box-spring beds, modern fully fitted kitchens as well as all necessary appliances and utensils one might need in an apartment. Every flat of ours has been individually furnished with an eye for warmth and detail. Furthermore, we only choose prime locations for our apartments. Our shared flats can primarily be found in Berlins most fancy and central residential areas.

With us, the rent you pay is an all-inclusive rent. No headaches, no subsequent payments or hidden costs. Everything is included: electricity, very fast 100 Mbit/s internet, water, heating and washing machine costs. You also don’t have to worry about any administrative TO DOs like city registration for example. We will take care of everything. Moreover, we offer a 24/7 Community Member Service for any issue that may arise, may it be a simple restaurant recommendation, city bureaucracyquestions or any form of personal emergency.

We carefully select every member of our community and thus fully trust them; this is also why we are the only co-living player on the market that does not require a deposit. We believe that our non-deposit policy liberates our clients from unnecessary financial burdens and gives them more flexibility within their fast-paced career lifestyles.

YOUR ROOM:
The room is particularly bright. The room is equipped with a king-sized box-spring bed with fine bedding as well as two bedside tables, a chest of drawers, a large mirror, a working desk with a corresponding chair, a floor lamp and a large closet. Moreover, the kitchen is fully fitted with cooking equipment and utensils. Furthermore, the bathroom has a bathtub shower and there is also a washing machine in the apartment.

LOCATION:
The room is located in a very beautiful and well-maintained old building in the middle of the hip Berlin district Kreuzberg close to Berlin Mitte! Ideal for interns and young professionals as it is close to the center of Berlin. The underground station Kottbusser Tor can be reached by foot within few minutes. Kreuzberg impresses by its cool style; it is the hotspot for charming cafes, bars and restaurants that serve specialities from all over the world.

description:

Complete high-quality furniture, dining area, TV, bed, sofa bed, fitted kitchen with built-in appliances, bathroom with shower, washing machine, floorboards, large windows and stucco decorations, including high-speed WiFi

You'll feel like a true local as you join the bustling crowds on Admiralbrücke Bridge, enjoying delicious pizza from the nearby Italian restaurant and sipping on local brews from the Spätshop convenience stores.

But the fun doesn't stop there! When you come home to our apartment, you'll be greeted by a spacious and comfortable living space that includes a cozy bedroom, a bright living room, a separate kitchen, a modern bathroom, and a convenient utility room. Plus, with the apartment being located on the top 5th floor, you'll get to enjoy amazing views of Berlin's typical architecture from the big windows that flood the apartment with natural light.

Our apartment is located in a brand-new building that was just finished in Spring 2023. One of the standout features of our apartment is the heat recuperation system and floor heating, which means that there's no wasted space for old-school radiators. This not only helps to save space, but it also ensures that you'll stay cozy and warm during the colder months.

We know that convenience is key, and that's why our apartment comes fully equipped with everything you need for a comfortable stay. The kitchen is fully stocked with appliances, including a dishwasher and an oven, while the washing machine and ironing machine make doing laundry a breeze. And for those who need to work from home, we've got you covered with a height-adjustable working table, high-speed internet connection, and a SmartTV.

But the best part of living in this apartment is the neighborhood! From concert venues to parks, an open swimming pool, skatepark, and open-air cinema, there's never a dull moment in Gräfekiez.

title: Blücherstraße, Berlin
description:
Welcome to Berlin! This beautiful Berliner high-ceiling apartment is in the very best location of Kreuzberg: between the Landwehrkanal, Bergmannkiez, and Hasenheide Park. Vibrant Graefekiez and Bergmannkiez offer various types of Berlin’s top ranked caffees, restaurants, and bars. These charming streets attract Berliners and tourists to the boutiques and the shopping centers all days in all seasons. Hasenheide Park is a heaven in the center, and Tempelhofer Feld follows the park with the historical and lively Berlin moods. A bit north, Landwehrkanal is a place to enjoy a picnic with to the view of the swans or a morning jog along the banks of the canal.
Many sports opportunities including swimming, gym, yoga, tennis are only a couple of minutes away. 
The Südstern U-Bahn connection is only a couple of steps away. In addition to being extremely close to the lively, and green areas of the city, the building is on a quiet street, and the flat is looking into a very peaceful inner yard.

The spacious flat is fully renovated and decorated with love. The real-wood floor living room includes a corner-sofa that can be turned into a double-bed, a dining table that can be extended, a working desk next to the huge windows, and a 43“ flat screen smart TV. The bedroom has a full size (140x200) double bed, a large wardrobe, a commode with a bedlight and a full body mirror. The bedroom includes all bedsheets, pillows and everything to start your accomodation. The kitchen is equipped with a washing machine, electric stove and oven, a foldable table for efficient meals, a cosy fridge, pans and cutlery. The day-light bath is renovated with top quality tiles, a walk-in shower, and a large mirror.

title: Nogatstraße, Berlin
description: Experience the perfect blend of luxury and convenience in this fantastic 41m2 apartment. With 2 rooms including a separate bedroom, en suite bathroom, and a tranquil ground floor location in a quiet Hinterhaus, this fully furnished space offers everything you need. Enjoy amenities like WiFi, a washing machine with dryer, coffee machine, desk, dishwasher, stove, and more. Relax in style with bed linens, towels, and a walk-in shower, all complemented by stunning stucco and wooden parquet flooring. Welcome to your dream living space.
